outcome: Maximal flow at functional residual capacity point (V'maxFRC)
cohort: The study included 150 infants (mean age 10.5 +/- 6 months), consisting of 104 preterm infants (median gestational age 34 weeks, range 28-36) and 46 term-born control infants.
finding: Preterm infants in the first year of life demonstrated a high prevalence of obstructive iPFT unresponsive to bronchodilators, with BPD status not significantly adding to the degree of pulmonary impairment.
followup_time: Around one year of age (mean age 10.5 +/- 6 months)
cross-section timing: Around one year of age (mean age 10.5 +/- 6 months)
birth_weight: Low birth weight (associated with reduced V'maxFRC)
gest_age: Preterm infants: median 34 weeks (range 28-36 weeks); Term infants: born at term
